subject: Timeout of resource seized dependent on an event

messages.author: c6b97521e7613e5f
messages.subject: Timeout of resource seized dependent on an event
parts:
Hi

I am modelling the flow of fuel to a petrol station. The petrol station is modelled as a resource and is seized for a timeout. I want to model "event A" which happens at a rate of rexp(1,1/100) and once it happens it would cause the timeout of the petrol station to change for a period of time before returning to its original timeout. Is there a way to model this? 

I tried using a signal trap handler but the signal sent subscribes to one arrival whereas I need the signal to be subscribed to every arrival that seizes the petrol station for the period of time the signal lasts.

fuel<-trajectory()%>%
  seize("terminal",1)%>%
  log_("Enters terminal ")%>%
  timeout(function() rexp(1, 5))%>%
  release("terminal",1)%>%
  log_("Leaves terminal")
  seize("petrol_station",1)%>%
  log_("Enters petrol station")%>%
  set_attribute("petrol arrival time", now(env_value), global=FALSE)%>%
  trap(signal,
     handler= trajectory()%>%
         log_("reduce timeout")%>%
         timeout(5)
  )%>%
  timeout(10)%>%
  release("petrol_station",1)%>%
  log_("Leaves petrol station")

event_A <- trajectory() %>%
  set_attribute("signal arrival time", now(env_value), global=FALSE)%>%
  send("event A occured")%>%
  timeout(20) %>%
  log_("event A ends")


env_value%>%
  add_resource("terminal",1)%>%
  add_resource("petrol_station", 1) %>%
  add_generator("fuel_unit", fuel, from(0, function() rexp(1, fuel_interarrival), arrive=TRUE), mon=2)%>% 
  add_generator("event_A", event_A, from(0, function() rexp(1,1/200), arrive=TRUE),
                priority = 1, mon=2) %>%
Thanks

S

  add_resource("petrol_station", 1) %>%
  add_generator("fuel_unit", fuel, from(0, function() rexp(1, fuel_interarrival), arrive=TRUE), mon=2)%>%

and in your event_A trajectory,
